title: Handle connector consent in Agents SDK
subtitle: Detect the consent card, show its details, then return Allow or Cancel.

steps.title: Detect the consent card
steps.evidence: Check for a TextBlock containing Connect to continue and Action.Submit buttons titled Allow and Cancel.

steps.title: Present security details and choice
steps.evidence: Detect consent Adaptive Cards, present their security details, and return the user's Allow or Cancel choice through the Agents SDK.

steps.title: Return the selected action
steps.evidence: Send a message activity with channelData.postBack set to true and value containing the selected action, id submit, and shouldAwaitUserInput true.
